target.statement: SVEAD achieves an average AUC-ROC of 0.8538 across 45 benchmark datasets, outperforming all 12 baselines.
target.dataset: ADBench 45-dataset benchmark (e.g., Pima, thyroid, wine, etc.)

compute.basis: SVEAD is a simple CPU algorithm (linear time, no training), but reproducing the average requires downloading 45 ADBench datasets, implementing the method, and running 5 repeats with grid search over m for each dataset; the paper's code link is anonymous and may be incomplete.

blockers: Anonymous code link may not be permanently available or may lack full configuration files
45 datasets must be downloaded and preprocessed from ADBench
Grid search over m (2^1 to 2^8) and 5 repeats per dataset adds runtime
title: Stochastic Voronoi Ensembles for Anomaly Detection
